class.name: SVG2D
class.brief_description: Renders SVG markup in a 2D scene.
class.description: SVG2D rasterizes SVG markup at the integer pixel dimensions it occupies in the viewport. It reuses the generated texture while those dimensions stay unchanged.

method.name: get_svg_size
method.description: Returns the SVG document's natural dimensions. The editor uses this rectangle for canvas selection and dragging.

method.name: get_texture
method.description: Returns the texture rasterized from [member src] at the current viewport density.

method.name: get_render_cache_bytes
method.description: Returns accounted render work-buffer bytes, excluding displayed textures, parsed XML and allocator overhead.

members.member: Keeps four jitter textures for reuse on unchanged shapes. Disable to update one texture in place, reducing retained texture memory by up to 75% but rasterizing again at each pattern change. Pattern timing and pixels are identical in both modes.

Keeps geometry, gradient, clip and pixel work buffers for subsequent rasterization. Disable to release them after each render while retaining the displayed texture and parsed document. This reduces retained memory but increases allocation and recomputation during zoom or jitter animation.
Enables the four-frame path jitter animation. Disabled nodes keep one normal texture and do not retain the three animation textures.
Number of rendered frames to hold each jitter pattern. The four fixed patterns cycle in order.

If [code]true[/code], redraws the SVG when its integer pixel dimensions in the viewport change. In the 2D editor, canvas zoom and display scale are included with at least 1.5x supersampling. The current texture is reused while those dimensions stay unchanged. Each texture axis is limited to 4096 pixels.
Mirrors the SVG horizontally inside its natural rectangle.
Mirrors the SVG vertically inside its natural rectangle.

Maximum peak-to-peak outline deformation across the four cached frames, as a ratio of the SVG document dimensions. No whole-shape translation is added. Used when [member animation_enabled] is enabled.
Moves the rendered SVG in its local coordinate system without changing its raster resolution.
An SVG file path to render, such as [code]res://art/icon.svg[/code]. Complete SVG markup is also accepted for compatibility and generated images.
